lista.descripcion: Stolen Cheers | Teen Alicia DeBolt goes missing shortly after making the cheer squad; police question members of the football team and fellow cheerleaders, but the truth behind this mystery is more sinister than anyone in her small Kansas town could have imagined.

lista.titulo: Murder Under the Friday Night Lights • A Homecoming Murder
lista.descripcion: A Homecoming Murder | The family of a high school cheerleader finds her murdered in her room the night after the homecoming dance; detectives surmise that she knew her killer, and because so many people are back in town for the big football game, everybody is a suspect.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • Murder at Sea
lista.descripcion: Murder at Sea | Vince Boston finds himself an unwitting accomplice to murder; he realizes his father, Silas, has been killing for years; he embarks on a mission to get justice for his father's many victims, which may include Vince's mother.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • The Hole in the Backyard
lista.descripcion: The Hole in the Backyard | When a hole appears in the backyard, Delila Yang gets suspicious; she knows her mother, Karina, dug it and knows someone is missing, but Delila doesn't yet realize she must work with police to trap her mom and unearth her sinister secrets.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • My Brother Let the Evil In
lista.descripcion: My Brother Let the Evil In | Christina Thomas believes her brother, John, the first time he nearly kills a woman; she forgives him when he murders another; but when it happens again, she wonders why she trusted him and how she missed the signs he was really a devil in disguise.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • She Hid the Knife in a Toybox
lista.descripcion: She Hid the Knife in a Toybox | When Jason Worley tries to escape from Brandi by filing for divorce, she punishes him by taking away the two things most precious to him.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • He Shot Through My Heart
lista.descripcion: He Shot Through My Heart | LaTonya believes her husband, Nathan, is her best friend; over the years she suffers emotional abuse at his hands and decides to take their kids and leave; Nathan refuses to let go, leading to a night of terror that ends in a tragedy and a miracle.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • Murder in the House of Prayer
lista.descripcion: Murder in the House of Prayer | As a child, Joy believes her mother, Anna Young, is the voice of God; in their isolated church community, Anna punishes anyone who breaks her rules, including young children; years later, Joy realizes her mother is not an angel but a killer.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • He Fed Him to Gators
lista.descripcion: He Fed Him to Gators | Craig Lester Thrift brags about getting away with murder, but everyone thinks he is kidding; Robyn Barry knows Thrift better than anyone, and she begins to suspect he isn't joking; someone needs to believe her before Thrift makes her his next victim.

lista.titulo: Signs of a Psychopath • Every Time Was Like Christmas
lista.descripcion: Every Time Was Like Christmas | Between 1991 and 2001, several violent sexual assaults occur along I-85 between Wyoming and Utah; the cases remain cold until almost two decades later, when advancements in DNA technology lead detectives straight to a psychopathic sexual predator.

lista.titulo: Signs of a Psychopath • He Got Such a Rush From It
lista.descripcion: He Got Such a Rush From It | Police charge a son and his wife with the murder of his father until a tip comes from a woman claiming her ex-husband and his friend admitted to the brutal killing; detectives interview the new suspects and uncover a pair of cold-blooded psychopaths.

lista.titulo: The Serial Killer Connection • Behind Closed Doors
lista.descripcion: Behind Closed Doors | Following a serial killer's military postings, Bonnie and Kara investigate murders in Maine, possible victims in San Diego, and chilling evidence in Virginia suggesting the serial killer's crimes stretched far beyond those officially known.

lista.descripcion: A Living Nightmare | Mandy marries a man twice her age and their relationship quickly turns suffocating and volatile; as the abuse escalates, she searches for answers until the truth emerges, and she fights to be believed and hold him accountable.
